answer: Escrowed rewards are released only after a random ocean-bound challenge period. In this window, auditors check proof copies against a crystal-clear snapshot. Fake identities must replay work during this wander delay, burning 0.3s per head. No parallel farmed identities escape this check. Cost scales linearly—each Sybil must redeem rewards individually. No spinning up thousands at once. The design forces slow, fixed per-agent costs.
